segments.ja260:1.3: Tassūdarassahaṃ dūto, mā me kujjha [kujjhi (sī. pī.)] rathesabha.
segments.ja260:2.1: Yassa divā ca ratto ca, vasamāyanti māṇavā;
segments.ja260:2.3: Tassūdarassahaṃ dūto, mā me kujjha [kujjhi (sī. pī.)] rathesabha.
segments.ja260:3.1: Dadāmi te brāhmaṇa rohiṇīnaṃ, gavaṃ sahassaṃ saha puṅgavena;
segments.ja260:3.3: Dūto hi dūtassa kathaṃ na dajjaṃ, mayampi tasseva bhavāma dūtāti.
segments.ja260:6.1: Usukāravaro tilamuṭṭhi maṇi, hayarāja vihaṅgama āsiviso;
segments.ja260:6.3: Janasandha kahāpaṇavassa puna, tiriṭaṃ puna dūtavarena dasāti.
